title: zero-dimensional-etale-finite
statement: For a separated, locally finite type, quasi-compact scheme C over an algebraically closed field k with topological Krull dimension at most zero, Finite C.

proof.text: By LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f, C is locally Noetherian. By QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f, C is compact. IsLocallyArtinian.of_topologicalKrullDim_le_zero hdim makes C locally Artinian and hence discrete. Therefore finite_of_compact_of_discrete proves Finite C (node lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-dim-zero-artinian).
